versions.localizedDescription:
## What's Changed
* Fix migration screen row overflow by @not-akari in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/884
* Fix History screen scroll lag by @not-akari in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/885
* Fix Updates and chapter list scroll lag by @not-akari in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/886
* Fix warning by @NBA2K1 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/887
* New feature: backup encryption by @NBA2K1 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/888
* fix: read downloaded chapters from disk instead of the source by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/889
* Fix chapter sort incorrectly and Added Missing Chapter Header by @not-akari in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/890
* Fix overflow in global search result cards by @not-akari in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/891
* Add live connection status to Sync screen, redesign layout by @not-akari in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/892
* Fixed reader where it launch and causing blank screen by @not-akari in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/893
* Fix Isar nested-transaction crash after backup restore and settings sync by @not-akari in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/894
* Fix blank reader screen on chapter change by @not-akari in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/895
* Surface the real error when an image fails to load by @not-akari in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/896
* Fix overflow in tracker library section screen by @not-akari in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/897
* Fix migration screen lag by @not-akari in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/898
* fix: stop a running update from the updates screen, and a grey box in its list by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/900
* fix: stop dropping decimal chapters and mismatching them on migration (#812) by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/899
* feat: a first run for a fresh install by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/901
* fix: stop settings writes putting back what changed in the meantime by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/904
* Cloudflare Issue Fixed by @not-akari in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/910
* Push restored data to sync server after a restore, guarding against r… by @not-akari in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/905
* Add dyslexia-friendly font options for novel reader text by @not-akari in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/908
* Use correct file extension for images by @NBA2K1 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/909
* Fix source-installed detection and add mangayomi-backup merge parity by @not-akari in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/907
* fix: stop share throwing on Linux, and give it something useful to do by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/903
* feat: keep the errors the app catches, and offer to report them by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/906


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/compare/v0.8.8...v0.8.9
